# AppointPanda

> Independent guides to dental treatment in the UAE, and a directory of dental clinics across all seven emirates. Guide prices are indicative AED ranges, not quotes. Clinic ratings come from Google and are shown as reported.

Content last reviewed: 2026-10-21. Editorial policy: https://www.appointpanda.ae/editorial-policy/

## Treatment guides
- [Dental Implants](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/dental-implants/): A dental implant is a small titanium or zirconia post placed in the jawbone to replace a missing tooth root, topped with a crown that looks and works like a natural tooth.
- [Invisalign & Clear Aligners](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/invisalign/): Invisalign is a brand of clear, removable aligners that move teeth gradually using a series of custom trays, each worn for about 22 hours a day.
- [Braces](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/braces/): Braces are fixed brackets and wires that apply steady pressure to move teeth and correct the bite, suitable for children, teens and adults.
- [Veneers](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/veneers/): Veneers are thin shells of porcelain or composite bonded to the front of teeth to change their colour, shape or size.
- [Hollywood Smile](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/hollywood-smile/): A "Hollywood smile" is a full smile makeover, usually veneers or crowns on most visible upper and lower teeth, planned to give an even, bright result.
- [Teeth Whitening](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/teeth-whitening/): Professional teeth whitening uses a peroxide gel, applied in the clinic or with custom home trays, to lighten the natural colour of teeth by several shades.
- [Root Canal Treatment](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/root-canal/): Root canal treatment removes infected or inflamed pulp from inside a tooth, cleans and seals the canals, and lets you keep the tooth instead of extracting it.
- [Teeth Cleaning (Scale & Polish)](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/teeth-cleaning/): A professional scale and polish removes hardened plaque (tartar) and surface stains that brushing cannot shift, helping prevent gum disease and decay.
- [Emergency Dentist](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/emergency-dentist/): An emergency dentist treats urgent problems such as severe toothache, swelling, a knocked-out tooth or a broken tooth, usually the same day.
- [Children's Dentistry](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/pediatric-dentistry/): Pediatric dentistry is dental care for babies, children and teens, focused on prevention, gentle treatment and keeping young patients comfortable.
- [Wisdom Tooth Removal](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/wisdom-tooth-removal/): Wisdom tooth removal is the extraction of one or more third molars, usually because they are impacted, infected or damaging neighbouring teeth.
- [Dental Crowns](https://www.appointpanda.ae/services/dental-crowns/): A dental crown is a custom cap that covers a damaged or weakened tooth to restore its shape, strength and appearance.

## Dentists by emirate
- [Dentists in Dubai](https://www.appointpanda.ae/dubai/): Dubai has the largest choice of private dental clinics in the UAE, from neighbourhood practices to specialist centres, licensed by the Dubai Health Authority or, inside Dubai Healthcare City, by its own regulator. Licensing: Dubai Health Authority (DHA).
- [Dentists in Abu Dhabi](https://www.appointpanda.ae/abu-dhabi/): Dental care in Abu Dhabi, including Al Ain and Al Dhafra, is regulated by the Department of Health - Abu Dhabi, with a mix of government hospital clinics and private practices. Licensing: Department of Health - Abu Dhabi (DoH).
- [Dentists in Sharjah](https://www.appointpanda.ae/sharjah/): Sharjah has a wide range of private dental clinics, many in Al Majaz, Al Nahda and Al Taawun, plus a university dental hospital, with prices that are often lower than in central Dubai. Licensing: Ministry of Health and Prevention (MOHAP).
- [Dentists in Ajman](https://www.appointpanda.ae/ajman/): Ajman is compact, so most residents can reach a dental clinic within a short drive. It also has university dental teaching facilities alongside private clinics. Licensing: Ministry of Health and Prevention (MOHAP).
- [Dentists in Ras Al Khaimah](https://www.appointpanda.ae/ras-al-khaimah/): Ras Al Khaimah has private clinics around RAK City and Al Nakheel, government hospital dental departments, and a dental college that trains future dentists. Licensing: Ministry of Health and Prevention (MOHAP).
- [Dentists in Fujairah](https://www.appointpanda.ae/fujairah/): Fujairah is the UAE's only emirate fully on the east coast. Clinics are concentrated in Fujairah City, with smaller practices in Dibba and other coastal towns. Licensing: Ministry of Health and Prevention (MOHAP).
- [Dentists in Umm Al Quwain](https://www.appointpanda.ae/umm-al-quwain/): Umm Al Quwain is the least populous emirate, with a small number of local clinics for routine care. Neighbouring Ajman and Sharjah offer wider specialist choice within a short drive. Licensing: Ministry of Health and Prevention (MOHAP).
